blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for corporate and M&A work — due diligence, closing, board governance, entity compliance, and post-closing integration. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: Corporate Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable Corporate Practice Profile across M&A, board/secretary, public-company, and entity-management work. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: Diligence Issue Extraction
prompts.description: Read uploaded data-room documents and extract diligence issues into a structured, house-format table.

prompts.title: Tabular Diligence Review
prompts.description: Tabular review of an uploaded document set — one row per document, one column per data point, every cell cited to source.

prompts.title: Material Contract Schedule
prompts.description: Build a material-contracts disclosure schedule from uploaded diligence findings or contracts.

prompts.title: Closing Checklist
prompts.description: Build and maintain a closing checklist from the uploaded deal documents — deliverables, conditions, critical path, and what is blocking.

prompts.title: Written Consent
prompts.description: Draft a board or committee unanimous written consent from an uploaded precedent, with conflict flags and a signatory checklist.

prompts.title: Board Minutes
prompts.description: Draft board or committee meeting minutes from an uploaded agenda and notes, in house format.

prompts.title: Entity Compliance
prompts.description: Build an entity compliance checklist from uploaded corporate records — qualifications, annual filings, registered agent, governance hygiene.

prompts.title: Post-Closing Integration
prompts.description: Track post-closing integration and survival obligations from the uploaded purchase agreement and ancillary documents.

prompts.title: Deal Team Summary
prompts.description: Turn a completed diligence or deal review into a concise summary for the deal team or business stakeholders.
